reply.text: Soreness in the triceps is something a doctor or physio should look at if it's sharp, worsening, or affecting your elbow or wrist, and I can't tell you whether it's safe to train through it. What I can do is help you plan around it: tell me what you'd like to do today and I'll check your program to see where upper sits this week. If you want, I can also check your recent sessions so we know how much dip work you've been doing.
